evals.prompt: Prepare a dry-run plan for the default warm thermal profile on an Intel host, with no CHRG option. Do not modify thermald. Show the trip ordering, cooling-device checks, generated XML/Planned Changes content, confirmation gate, sole-authority flags, and rollback path.
evals.expected_output: Provide a dry-run-only thermal plan with fail-closed checks, warm trip points, confirmation outcome, expected thermald authority settings, and rollback guidance without claiming service changes.
expectations: Resolves warm to Fan 60 C, Processor 75 C, and powerclamp 85 C with Fan < Processor < powerclamp ordering
Lists script, thermald/applicability, Intel/x86, cooling-device, and sudo checks while preserving an unprivileged dry-run
Places generated XML and Planned Changes before confirmation and records dry_run_only without service-change claims
Uses default charge=false and explains absent cooling devices and expected sole-authority flags: --ignore-default-control and no --adaptive
Provides config backup/restore guidance and disable=true as the kernel-default thermal-control rollback
